item.title: 3,000 cops, one leader: Udhayanidhi decries 'terrorist'-style arrest by TVK govt
item.summary: Opposition leaders criticized Udhayanidhi Stalin's arrest, calling it unwarranted. They stated the arrest aimed to divert attention from government failures. DMK cadres protested across Tamil Nadu following the opposition leader's detention. TVK ministers defended the government's action and Udhayanidhi's remarks were deemed obscene. Udhayanidhi vowed to legally challenge the case, calling it politically motivated.
